title: The First Row of Knitting
youtube_title: The First Row of Knitting | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A shy try, done kindly, is already courage.
summary: At a lantern walk along the evening lane, Farah feels shy about a first row of knitting in front of Nana. Instead of pretending not to care, Farah tries the smallest brave version in a voice that can be heard, while Nana Ruth stays kind and does not push for a show.
